protocol: v4, pre-registered before any v4 classifier, score or augmented feature is computed
parents: protocol_v3_continuation.json (immutable; their freezes and outputs are not modified)

data.never_read_reason: The v3 reserved test has already been scored; it must not choose model, hyper-parameter, threshold or appear in v4 metrics.
data.augmentation_sources: OpenSLR SLR28 rirs_noises.zip (Apache 2.0), never used in any earlier round; no ESC-50, Pete or HumBug audio is used for augmentation.

representations.perch_white: v3 cache: Perch v2 ONNX, unmodified weights, per-recording 20th-percentile spectral whitening, mean 1536-d embedding per file.
representations.band_tabular: v3 cache tabular_white without mel bands centred below 300 Hz (bands 0-4: 133, 166, 202, 238, 276 Hz): mean and std of bands 5-39 plus the 9 wingbeat descriptors = 79 values.
representations.wingbeat: v3 cache tabular_white columns 80-88 (9 wingbeat descriptors).
representations.coral: PCA to 128 dimensions fitted on fitting rows of the fold; then, separately for every origin, Ledoit-Wolf covariance and mean of that origin's rows are matched to those of all fitting rows (CORAL). Origin statistics use features only, never labels. For the held-out corpus the statistics come from its unlabeled evaluation files: transductive, declared, requires an unlabeled local batch at deployment.
representations.augmented: One augmented copy per development file (copy 0), deterministic seed from (augmentation seed, file_id). Chain on the decoded 8 kHz waveform before the inherited band-pass and whitening: (1) microphone simulation: 2nd-order high-pass at U(100, 600) Hz, 4th-order low-pass at U(2000, 3400) Hz, two peaking biquads with gain U(-9, 9) dB, centre log-uniform 150-3000 Hz, Q U(0.7, 3); (2) with p=0.5 convolution with a random real RIR from SLR28 real_rirs_isotropic_noises, resampled to 8 kHz; (3) with p=0.8 additive SLR28 noise (point-source or isotropic) at SNR U(0, 20) dB; (4) gain U(-20, 6) dB and hard clipping at |x| <= 1. Features are then recomputed with the unchanged v3 code path (perch_white, tabular_white). Augmented rows are added only to fitting rows, keep the original file's cluster, and each original+augmented pair carries one unit of training mass. Calibration and evaluation always use original audio.

A0_perch_white.head: logistic
A0_perch_white.note: reference = v3 A_perch_white under the v4 protocol

B2_wingbeat.head: logistic
B2_wingbeat.note: also the concordance gate, as in v3

diagnostic_only.R_tabular_full: HistGB on all 89 tabular_white values; used only as the 'before' reference for band occlusion and source probe, never selectable.

heads.histgb: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, max_leaf_nodes in [15, 31], max_iter 200, learning_rate 0.05, l2 1.0, no early stopping.
heads.dann: StandardScaler + Linear(d,256)+ReLU feature extractor, dropout 0.2, label head Linear(256,1), domain head Linear(256,64)+ReLU+Linear(64,n_origins) behind gradient reversal; lambda in [0, 0.3, 1]; AdamW lr 0.001, weight decay 0.001, 20 epochs, batch 256.
heads.selection: 3 inner StratifiedGroupKFold folds by cluster_merged on fitting rows only, balanced accuracy at logit 0, as in v3.
heads.class_weights: balanced per class within the rows being fitted

two_stage_and_calibration: As v3: stage 1 presence (mosquito vs noise), stage 2 Aedes among mosquitoes; deterministic cluster split of the training side into fitting (75%) and calibration (25% of clusters per cluster-max class); logistic probability maps and the alert threshold are fitted on calibration only; threshold = smallest score keeping calibration FPR <= 2% in other mosquitoes and <= 1% in noise; if none, no alerts.
gate: Each candidate is evaluated gated (disagreement with B2_wingbeat about Aedes -> 'uncertain', kept in denominators) and ungated. Gated/ungated is part of the candidate identity and is chosen on development only.

evaluations.lodo_mosquito: Hold out each of abuzz, humbug, mosquitosong (all development files of that origin); train on the rest. Training clusters that also occur in the held-out set are removed. bdc_unknown is never held out (one Aedes cluster).
evaluations.lodo_noise: Hold out each noise source esc50, pete_noise (all its files) and evaluate FPR in noise only; mosquito files stay in training.
evaluations.fewshot_calibration: For every candidate and lodo_mosquito corpus, k in [5, 10, 20] files per class from at most half of the held-out clusters per class, 5 repeats; recalibrate only the probability maps and threshold (heads unchanged) on those files; evaluate on held-out files of untouched clusters. Arms without enough clusters are reported as unavailable.
evaluations.metrics: Per corpus: recall, FPR in other mosquitoes, FPR in noise, precision, coverage, balanced accuracy, AUROC, AUPRC; 95% CI by cluster-stratified bootstrap (2000 draws, unit cluster_merged); degenerate intervals with zero events are flagged and the per-file binomial CI is reported as description only.
evaluations.source_probe: Among mosquito files of origins with >= 10 clusters (abuzz, humbug, mosquitosong), predict origin with StandardScaler+LogisticRegression(C=1, class_weight balanced), 5 StratifiedGroupKFold folds by cluster; report balanced accuracy vs chance 1/3 for perch_plain, perch_white, coral(perch_white), tabular_white, band_tabular, wingbeat.
evaluations.group_alignment: Gaussian-kernel MMD (median bandwidth) between origins within the 'other mosquito' class, perch_white vs coral(perch_white), on PCA-128 features, 500 files per origin sampled with the global seed.
evaluations.band_occlusion: For B1, C1 and R_tabular_full on lodo_mosquito test files: replace each mel band group (5 contiguous groups of the bands present) by the fitting-row mean and report mean |delta p(Aedes)| and mean delta on Aedes files.
evaluations.sex_strata: MosquitoSong recall and FPR by sex (from file names), descriptive only.

selection.measurable_targets: recall >= 0.20 and FPR other <= 0.02 in each lodo_mosquito corpus; FPR noise <= 0.01 in lodo_mosquito humbug and in each lodo_noise source.
rule: Eligible at k=0 if every measurable target holds (point estimates).
Else eligible at the smallest k in [5,10,20] where every target holds on the median of the 5 repeats in every lodo_mosquito corpus, with zero-shot noise targets.
Among eligible: highest mean precision, tie -> highest mean AUROC.
If none eligible: freeze the highest mean lodo_mosquito AUROC as a descriptive fallback and report that none was eligible.

final_freeze: After selection, the chosen candidate (gated or ungated) is refitted on all development files with the same split rule and seeds; weights, maps and threshold are saved and their SHA-256 written to reanalysis/outputs/v4/final_freeze.json before any new-test data is read.

eligibility: devices (models) and locations never used in any round
>= 10 independent Aedes aegypti clusters (cage x session x device) and >= 10 clusters of other mosquitoes, preferably Ae. albopictus and Culex quinquefasciatus, recorded in the same device/day blocks
ambient noise recorded in the same blocks
new_test.procedure: Manifest frozen by SHA-256 before any scoring; the frozen v4 model is scored exactly once; success uses v3_metrics.success per corpus with one-sided cluster-bootstrap bounds and >= 5 Aedes clusters.

not_executed.perch_finetuning_or_lora: No GPU on this machine; cost of back-propagating Perch v2 over ~10k files on CPU judged prohibitive. Frozen-embedding heads (A0) remain the baseline.
not_executed.temperature_sex_as_inputs: Available only for MosquitoSong (sex, 25 C) and part of HumBug; used as descriptive strata only.

amendments: Any change after freezing is recorded as a numbered amendment with reason, timestamp and new hashes; results computed before an amendment are kept.
